rounds.text: Reliance Infrastructure Ltd presents severe fundamental deterioration beneath its optically low valuation multiples [E1, E2]. Long-term top-line contraction is evident as compounded sales growth over a 10-year period sits at negative 2%, compounded by poor sales growth of only 3.59% over the past five years [E8, E56]. Recent performance confirms this stagnation, with year-over-year sales declining by 3% [E67] and trailing twelve-month profit growth collapsing by 47% [E15]. This sharp drop aligns with explicit warnings that earnings growth is actively decelerating [E68]. Furthermore, the company offers a zero percent dividend yield, returning nothing to shareholders while they shoulder these operational headwinds [E4]. Conceded: the company trades at a low price-to-book ratio of 0.18x alongside a 15.4% ROCE and a 14.3% ROE [E2, E6, E7].
